fields.name: authorization_token
fields.help: AuthorizationToken returned by GET https://openapi.tvc-mall.com/Authorization/GetAuthorization?email=…&password=… once your account manager has enabled the OPEN API (1-3 working days). Sent as `Authorization: TVC <token>` ('The authorization string must start with the prefix "TVC"').

me.note: No account endpoint; the probe reads the top-level category list (GET /OpenApi/Category/GetChildren without ParentCode), so `account` is {CateoryList}. A rejected token answers HTTP 200 {Message: 'unauthorized'}, reported as auth_error.

get_product.note: GET /OpenApi/Product/Detail?ItemNo= — `id` is the ItemNo (SKU, e.g. 660166037C). ProductStatus: 1 Normal, 2 Out of Stock, 3 Locked, 4 Pre-sold, 5 Group-buy; PriceList gives the quantity price breaks (raw.PriceList). Prices are in the account currency (not returned here). Images are in GET /OpenApi/Product/DetailWithImages (not mapped).

quote_shipping.note: POST /order/shippingcost {skuinfo: 'ItemNo*quantity', countrycode (ISO-2)}: Shippings [{ShippingMethodCode, ShippingMethod, ShippingCost, DeliveryCycle}] in the response Currency (raw is not returned; USD by default). Pass `quantity` explicitly: skuinfo is left out without it. When no freight exists the platform answers Success false with a Reason and an empty list.

get_order.note: GET /order/Info?orderid= (e.g. V23120200014): OrderID, Currency, OriginalAmount, DiscountedAmount (amount due), ShippingMethodName, OrderAddressInfo, Trackingnumbers[], CreatedOn, ModifiedOn, Items[{SKU, Name, UnitPrice, Quantity, Subtotal}]. The response has no status field (status is null).

not_offered.list_products: GET /OpenApi/Product/Search pages by cursor: lastProductId is 'Required for all request but the first one. The biggest ProductId you get in previous request.' There is no page number or keyword parameter, so the vocabulary's page/query cannot drive it (a page 2 request would repeat page 1).
not_offered.create_order: POST /order/AddOrder and POST /order/bulkadd take `skus` as one string 'Fomart:<SKU>*<Quantity>, separated by comma'; the runtime cannot join the vocabulary's items array into that string.
not_offered.track: No tracking-events endpoint; tracking numbers are the Trackingnumbers[] array of GET /order/Info (see get_order).

evidence: host openapi.tvc-mall.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (Google Trust Services)
probe: 4/4 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 404 (not_found), so the answers are path-specific
HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 3/3 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; every parameter and body key named on the page
